t.name: Jordan Creek Trail #94
t.description: This trail provides access to Goat Ridge above Jordan Basin within Goat Rocks Wilderness.

t.name: Lily Basin Trail #86
t.description: This trail provides access to the Goat Rocks Wilderness. Views of Packwood Lake and Mt. Rainier are available from this trail. Parts of this trail may have been a Native American travel route, used by mountain goat hunters.

t.name: Goat Ridge Trail #95
t.description: The trail climbs steeply up Goat Ridge to a junction with the Lily Basin Trail.
